title: 전자레인지 쓰기: 어떤 버튼을 몇 번 눌러요?
objective: By the end, you can choose the right microwave button and read how long to heat food from a package label.
summary: Learn to read the buttons on a Korean microwave and the heating directions on food packages and containers.
note: The panel and labels are examples; button names can be a little different on each microwave.

task.title: Read and choose
task.line: Use the buttons, labels, and tips on page 1 to answer each question.

steps.en: hear the beep, take it out

sections.heading: Words on the panel and labels

items.text: Press it to stop heating or clear the time.
Use it to warm up cold food.
Use it for frozen food like meat or bread.
This container can go in the microwave.
A warning: do not put this in the microwave.
Labels often tell you to open the lid a little.

sections.heading: Tip: reading a food package
paragraphs: Example label: 즉석밥 | 뚜껑을 조금 열고 전자레인지에 2분. First find the numbers with 분 (minutes) and 초 (seconds): 1분 30초 means 1 minute 30 seconds. Then check what to do before heating, like opening the 뚜껑.
Always look at the bottom of a bowl or cup. 전자레인지용 means yes. 사용 금지 means no.

exercises: Which button do you press? Choose 데우기, 해동, or 취소: ① 어제 먹은 피자가 차가워요. ② 냉동실에서 고기를 꺼냈어요. 아직 딱딱해요. ③ 시간을 잘못 눌렀어요.
Read the package and answer in Korean. How long do you heat it?: 냉동 볶음밥 | 전자레인지 3분 30초 | 비닐을 조금 열어 주세요.
You want to heat food for 2분 20초. How many times do you press each button?: 1분 버튼 ( )번, 10초 버튼 ( )번
Can this go in the microwave? Write O or X: ① 그릇 바닥: 전자레인지용 ② 컵 스티커: 전자레인지 사용 금지 ③ 도시락: 뚜껑을 조금 열고 전자레인지에 1분
Fill in the blank with 강 or 약: 빵이 너무 뜨겁고 딱딱해요. 다음에는 세기를 ____으로 하세요.
Put the steps in order: ㄱ. 3분을 맞춰요. ㄴ. 우유를 넣고 문을 닫아요. ㄷ. 시작을 눌러요. ㄹ. 문을 열어요.
answers: ① 데우기 ② 해동 ③ 취소
① O ② X ③ O
